title: Conductor
content: A conductor is a substance which conducts or allows the passage of electricity.
e: A conductor is a substance which conducts or allows the passage of electricity. Conductor is a substance which conducts or allows.

title: Electrolyte
content: An electrolyte is a substance in the molten state or as a solution in water, which allows the passage of electricity.
e: An electrolyte is a substance in the molten state or as a solution in water, which allows the passage of electricity. An electrolyte ionises in solution or in the molten state so the ions can carry current. In the molten state ionic compounds have mobile ions, so they conduct and can be electrolysed.

title: Electrolysis
content: Electrolysis is the decomposition of a compound, in solution or in the molten state, brought about by the passage of an electric current through it.
e: Electrolysis is the decomposition of a compound, in solution or in the molten state, brought about by the passage of an electric current through it. In the molten state ionic compounds have mobile ions, so they conduct and can be electrolysed. Electrolysis uses electrical energy to force a non-spontaneous chemical change.

title: Cathode
content: Cathode is a negative electrode and donates electrons.
e: Cathode is a negative electrode and donates electrons. Electrodes are the conductors where oxidation and reduction happen during electrolysis. The cathode is the electrode where reduction occurs.

title: Anode
content: An anode is a positive electrode and accepts electrons.
e: An anode is a positive electrode and accepts electrons. Electrodes are the conductors where oxidation and reduction happen during electrolysis. The anode is the electrode where oxidation occurs.

title: Electrochemical Cell
content: An electrochemical cell is a device that converts chemical energy into electrical energy or vice versa when a chemical reaction occurs by electrical energy.
e: An electrochemical cell is a device that converts chemical energy into electrical energy or vice versa when a chemical reaction occurs by electrical energy. An electrochemical cell converts chemical energy to electrical energy, or the reverse in electrolysis. Electrochemical Cell is the word this version is asking about.

title: Electroplating
content: Electroplating is a process to coat one metal with a thin layer of another metal by electrolysis.
e: Electroplating is a process to coat one metal with a thin layer of another metal by electrolysis. Electrolysis uses electrical energy to force a non-spontaneous chemical change. Electroplating uses electrolysis to coat an object with a thin layer of metal.
